name: ZeroCloud Hub
description: Discover, install and update your ZeroCloud apps in one place.
introduction: We’re building Hub to make finding and managing ZeroCloud apps easier. Here’s what we’re working towards.

steps.title: Find an app
steps.description: Browse the ZeroCloud family and choose what you need.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description: Get the right build for your device from the same place.

steps.title: Keep it current
steps.description: See available updates alongside the apps you use.

note.title: Hub is optional.
note.description: Every app will remain available as a direct download. Use Hub when it suits you.

faqs.question: Do I need Hub to use the other apps?
faqs.answer: No. Hub is optional. Each ZeroCloud app will remain available on its own.

faqs.question: What is Hub for?
faqs.answer: Hub is being built as one place to discover ZeroCloud apps, install them and keep track of available updates.

faqs.question: Can I use Hub in a browser?
faqs.answer: A Web option is listed alongside the app downloads. There is no public web URL yet.
